definitions.explanation: A political and economic theory advocating collective or governmental ownership and administration of the means of production.

{社会主義|しゃかいしゅぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理念|りねん}→理念：06027_rinen⟧。
{社会主義|しゃかいしゅぎ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{資本主義|しほんしゅぎ}→資本主義：05414_shihonshugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧。

notes:
{社会主義|しゃかいしゅぎ} refers to socialism as a political and economic ideology advocating collective ownership.
